## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, what happened before, and what this change makes happen.

## Scope and contracts

- Related issue:
- Roadmap IDs (for example B.02, D.04):

- Remaining limitations:

## Verification

List the exact commands/checks performed and their outcomes. Distinguish native,
portable core, UI, live integration and hosted CI. Include failed attempts that
matter and any checks not run. UI changes need inspected captures.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change follows AGENTS.md and relevant module contracts.
- [ ] Document edits retain revision checks, atomicity and explicit rejection.
- [ ] Applicable tests/checks ran; evidence and limitations are recorded above.
- [ ] Documentation and affected roadmap status reflect the final behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private user documents or unauthorized third-party content are included.
- [ ] Dependency notices are preserved and any new dependency's terms are identified.
- [ ] Release identity, if changed, comes from release.json; document versions change only when required by persisted features.
